title: Dia de Sorte 1317: How the Draw Works and Where to Claim the Prize
seoTitle: Dia de Sorte 1317: How It Works & How to Claim
subtitle: Understand the steps of the draw held this Wednesday (7) in São Paulo
excerpt: Dia de Sorte 1317 was drawn this Wednesday (7) in São Paulo. Learn how to pick numbers, use the Lucky Month, bet online, and claim the prize.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Draw 1317 of Dia de Sorte was held this Wednesday (7) in São Paulo, drawing strong interest from players targeting the so-called “Lucky Month.”

How Dia de Sorte works

To participate, players must select between 7 and 15 numbers out of 31 available and pick a “Lucky Month.” In each draw, seven numbers and one month are drawn, with prizes distributed across five tiers: 4, 5, 6, and 7 correct numbers, in addition to matching the Lucky Month.

Where and how to bet

Caixa Econômica Federal offers the Loterias Online portal and the Loterias Caixa app, available for iOS and Android. The platforms operate 24 hours a day, allowing individuals aged 18 and over to place bets from any computer or smartphone. All bets are linked to the registered CPF.

Draw times and locations

Loterias Caixa draws take place from Sunday to Friday at Espaço da Sorte in São Paulo. On weekdays, the draw takes place at 9 p.m.; on Sundays, it is held at 11 a.m. On certain occasions, the venue may change, but any changes are announced in advance in the monthly draw calendar.

How to claim the prize

Caixa branches allow the redemption of any prize amount. Prizes exempt from income tax can be claimed at lottery outlets or via Mercado Pago, with transfer to the bank account linked to the CPF used for the bet. Only the holder of the CPF registered or a legally recognized proxy may withdraw the funds.

Purpose of the digital platforms

According to Caixa, the digital tools aim to provide convenience to players and reach a younger audience, expanding access to the lottery safely and practically.

With information from GZH.
